sections.intro: The menu wanders across cuisines, some dishes traditional and some with our own take. Our standard is excellence in the food, the service and the room.

sections.title: Named for a land of *mystery, magic and adventure*
body: The Wildemount takes its name from a continent in Dungeons & Dragons, and Chef Samuel O'Lone brings the same sense of adventure to the kitchen. Self-taught, with a degree in theology, he has been making things since he was a kid and loves creating new dishes.

His brothers and sisters moved to Aiken with him, and several of them work in the restaurant. We took over the Park Avenue home of Solo Vino Wine Parlor, whose former owners helped us find our footing.

items.text: Fine dining, but casual. Date night and business dinners both fit right in.

items.title: Ask about the evening
items.text: Seafood arrives three times a week, so ask your server what's fresh.

sections.text: Call ahead to reserve, and let us know if you're celebrating.

before: No website of its own: a search leads to a social page or a directory listing
Directory listings spell the restaurant's name two different ways
Hours and how to reserve are spread across other people's sites
after: A site the restaurant owns, at its own address
Hours, phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call to reserve on a phone
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room to add the menu, photos and specials as the owner supplies them
